local companies = tool('list_companies', {})
local by_domain = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  if c.domain then by_domain[string.lower(c.domain)] = c.name end
end

local all, page = {}, 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  for _, ct in ipairs(r.items) do all[#all + 1] = ct end
  page = page + 1
until page > r.total_pages

local phones_fixed, companies_filled = 0, 0
local updated, skipped = {}, {}

for _, ct in ipairs(all) do
  local upd = { id = ct.id }
  local changed = false

  -- phone
  local p = ct.phone
  if p and not string.match(p, '^%+1%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d$') then
    local digits = p:gsub('%D', '')
    local np = nil
    if #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1,1) == '1' then np = '+' .. digits
    elseif #digits == 10 then np = '+1' .. digits end
    if np then
      upd.phone = np
      changed = true
      phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
    end
  end

  -- company
  if (not ct.company or ct.company == '') and ct.email then
    local domain = ct.email:match('@(.+)$')
    local match = domain and by_domain[string.lower(domain)] or nil
    if match then
      upd.company = match
      changed = true
      companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
    end
  end

  if changed then
    local res = tool('update_contact', upd)
    updated[#updated + 1] = { id = ct.id, phone = res.phone, company = res.company }
  else
    skipped[#skipped + 1] = ct.id
  end
end

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled,
         updated_count = #updated, skipped = skipped, updated = updated }
